extraFacts.fact: NPS is the nominal pipe size in inches and DN the matching metric nominal diameter (NPS 1 = DN25, NPS 2 = DN50, NPS 12 = DN300); ASME Class numbers such as 150, 300, 600, 900, 1500 and 2500 are pressure-temperature rating classes defined for valves in ASME B16.34, so the allowable pressure at a given temperature depends on the class and the body material.
